conditions: 1920x1080, warmup 60 + 240 frames, no sky unless noted. RC = world-48-voxel-rc2-vrel, DDGI = ddgi-75-128-u4-g1-noadapt (both multi-bounce by default after this phase). Before = phase 22 runner. GPU times: no reference render running.

design.rc: bounce volume (src/core/bounce.ts): camera-centred probes every 1.2 m (32x16x32), 16 fixed rays + 6 axis reach rays, each probe traced every 2 frames, ambient cube; hits read prev volume; per-voxel injection (both sides) read by cascade hits
design.ddgi: probes read back their own irradiance (previous update) at hits; trace and blend split into two passes
design.reference: scripts/reference_irradiance.py --bounces 0 (unbounded, Russian roulette from the third hit); --bounces 1 reproduces the old one-bounce reference bit for bit

found: the volume's own rays skipping the probe's coarse voxel saw through thin walls (leak 0.39 -> 1.75 %); tracing the first segment on level 0 with no skip and a three-axis reach test fixed the volume's leak; the remaining rise is the field's own leak multiplied by the interreflection inside the closed room
reading 8 probes per cascade hit cost 0.6 ms; per-voxel injection costs about 0.1 ms
faint blocky patches on the near floor (one bounce value per coarse voxel)
the reference with unbounded bounces takes about 26 min per 256 spp on 32 threads (one bounce 4.5 min per 512 spp)
